title: Tutorial Info
content: Hello, this is a page to share your important links with minimal coding.

title: How does this work?
content: This text, and the links below dynamically displayed based on the content of a text file (json file). Follow these steps and you can make your own site!

title: Things you need!
content: A Github account, a web browser, and a text editor. Notepad will do, but something like Notepad++ or VSCode can make things easier as they will highlight the code.

title: How can people visit my website?
content: Github has a features called 'Github Pages'. It allows you to host a small website for free. There are some limitations. But nothing that will imapct this project. Follow the Github pages quickstart guide below to get that setup.
